rubric_content.text_property: The result_chat_response is concise: 1-3 sentences, maximum 100 words. It summarizes what was done without excessive detail or verbosity.
The response is written in the same language as the user's original request. If the user wrote in French, the response is in French; if in English, the response is in English.
The response uses plain text only: no markdown formatting (no **, #, -, etc.), no emojis, no code blocks, no HTML. Just natural conversational text.
